actionLog: Implemented by a concurrent run as PR #72: turned the recurring-malfunctions widget's flat row list into a labeled table (header row + the already-computed-but-unshown stock-qty column from repairLeaderboard()). Bookkeeping applied by a later run that found the PR already open on origin/main's latest tip but the note still unbookkept. Both PRs are real and open — a human should pick one to merge and close the other, not merge both.
